Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: scientific causal mechanism diagram background. The attached image is the EDIT TARGET: it is the new candidate generated during this task, not the old book figure.
Change only the quantitative chart artwork in FIVE slots. Remove EVERY coloured vertical rectangular probability bar AND its horizontal chart baseline/axis, leaving clean empty panel interiors in their places: (1) upper-left blue prior panel, (2) upper-middle cyan posterior panel, (3) upper-right green result panel, (4) lower-left blue prior panel, (5) lower-right green result panel. Remove exactly these bars and axes. The empty chart areas will later receive precisely computed Matplotlib plots. Do not replace them with other charts, ticks, numbers, or decorative marks.
KEEP all five surrounding rounded panel borders and their pale backgrounds, all ten state/outcome circular dots beneath the five chart slots, the two orange intervention mapping panels and their grey mapping objects/circular endpoints/internal arrows, every inter-panel arrow, and the top factual evidence document icon and connector. There must remain two state dots under each now-empty chart slot. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, symbols, letters, numbers or pseudowriting. Pure white canvas and uniform pale panel fills, flat 2D. No texture, ripple, grain, shadow, gradient, glow, perspective, or extrusion.
